comment: Point-in-time API list rates, $/M tokens [input, output]. Each period applies from its effective_from date (inclusive) until the next period's date. When Anthropic changes prices, APPEND a new period; never edit an old one. Days are priced with the period in effect on that day, so rate changes never re-price history. Cache multipliers: reads 10% of input rate, 5-min cache writes 1.25x, 1-hour cache writes 2x.
